result.summary: A residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides, but lacking marked pedestrian infrastructure at the intersection. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near corners create potential safety risks for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross the street.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps at the intersection, creating barriers for people with mobility devices or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.
